description.zh: 在「新会话」下方新增网页对话入口；点击进入 DeepSeek Chat 模式，左侧栏换成 CHAT 品牌、会话历史与「返回 Harness」，面板里跑官方 chat-demo 界面，请求用 DSH 账号走 API，并可按 30/60/90 天或永不自动清理旧会话。
description.en: Adds a Web Chat entry that opens a DeepSeek Chat mode: the sidebar becomes CHAT branding, chat history and a Back to Harness action, while the panel runs the official chat-demo UI proxied through your signed-in account, with a 30/60/90-day or never retention policy.
